updates.text: Added Samepage Bets, feedback to shipped work with PM agents
Added Figma agent, the on-canvas design agent in Figma
Added Wonder, a design canvas that works with coding agents
New workflow: library-true screen to shipped code
Windsurf is now listed as Devin Desktop
Added 5 workflows that chain these tools

agents.name: Samepage Bets
agents.oneLiner: Pulls customer feedback into one place, ranks it, then has agents research, spec and ship the work.
agents.standout: Turns scattered feedback from calls, tickets and chat into scored bets, with a human approving each agent step.
agents.pricing: Free plan; Pro $15/mo, Teams $25/user/mo billed yearly

agents.name: Figma agent
agents.oneLiner: An AI agent inside Figma Design that plans and carries out multi-step design tasks on your canvas.
agents.forWho: Product designers and design teams on paid Figma plans
agents.standout: Builds and refines screens from your own library components, tokens and variables instead of placeholder UI.

agents.name: Wonder
agents.oneLiner: A design canvas where you and your coding agents work on the real product, and the design stays as code.
agents.standout: Runs Claude Code or Codex on your own subscription, each in its own git worktree, beside the design.

agents.name: Figma Make
agents.oneLiner: Turns prompts, frames and design kits into working, editable prototypes inside Figma.
agents.standout: Click any element in the live preview to restyle or re-prompt it, then copy it to canvas.

agents.name: Stitch
agents.oneLiner: Generates mobile and web UI screens plus front-end code from text or sketches.
agents.forWho: Designers and developers exploring early UI
agents.standout: Upload a whiteboard sketch or screenshot and get a digital design you can paste into Figma.

agents.name: Uizard
agents.oneLiner: AI UI design tool that generates screens, themes and prototypes from prompts.
agents.standout: Scan a hand-drawn wireframe or app screenshot and turn it into an editable mockup.

agents.name: Lovable
agents.oneLiner: Builds and hosts full apps from plain-language chat, backend included.
agents.forWho: Non-developers building products and internal tools
agents.standout: Go from a described idea to a deployed app with hosting, auth and payments handled.
agents.pricing: Free plan (daily build credits); paid plans, see site

agents.name: Bolt
agents.oneLiner: Chat-based builder for websites, apps, slides and prototypes with built-in hosting.
agents.standout: Start a build from an existing Figma design or GitHub repo and keep your design system.

agents.name: v0
agents.oneLiner: Prompt-to-web-app builder that plans, codes and deploys full-stack sites.
agents.forWho: Designers and developers shipping web apps
agents.standout: Tweak generated UI visually in Design Mode, sync to GitHub, deploy to Vercel in one click.

agents.name: Replit Agent
agents.oneLiner: Chat agent that writes, tests, fixes and publishes apps for you.
agents.forWho: Founders, PMs and designers without coding skills
agents.standout: Tests the app in a browser while it builds, reports bugs and fixes them itself.
agents.pricing: Free to start; Core from $20/mo ($18 billed annually)

agents.name: Magic Patterns
agents.oneLiner: AI design workspace that turns prompts and PRDs into high-fidelity UI.
agents.standout: Import your component library so generated concepts match your design system, then hand off to a coding agent.

agents.name: Dovetail
agents.oneLiner: Pulls customer feedback from many sources into cited insights, chat and agents.
agents.forWho: Researchers, designers and PMs at larger orgs
agents.standout: Agents automate recurring stakeholder updates and route ranked customer needs to Jira, Linear or Cursor.
agents.pricing: Paid; from $4,800/yr plus credits; 30-day free trial

agents.name: Maze
agents.oneLiner: Recruit participants, run tests and interviews, and get AI-assisted analysis.
agents.standout: Run unmoderated prototype tests with a 6M+ participant panel and auto-generated reports.

agents.name: Listen Labs
agents.oneLiner: AI-moderated customer interviews at scale, from study design to slides.
agents.forWho: UX researchers, PMs and insights teams
agents.standout: An AI moderator interviews participants in 120+ languages and every finding links back to its interview.

agents.name: Outset
agents.oneLiner: Runs hundreds of AI-moderated video, voice or text interviews at once.
agents.standout: Generates the interview guide from your goals, then delivers themes, highlight reels and decks.

agents.name: ChatPRD
agents.oneLiner: AI product-management assistant that drafts, reviews and prototypes specs.
agents.standout: Turns meeting notes into a PRD, scores it, then opens it in v0, Lovable or Cursor.

agents.name: Linear Agent
agents.oneLiner: Issue tracker where AI agents are workspace members you can assign work to.
agents.standout: Delegate an issue to Cursor, Codex or ChatPRD and watch each change and its reasoning.
agents.pricing: Free plan includes agents; paid from $10/user/mo billed yearly

agents.name: Notion Agent
agents.oneLiner: Workspace agent that builds and edits pages and databases across connected apps.
agents.forWho: PMs and teams documenting work in Notion
agents.standout: Custom Agents run on a schedule to answer Slack questions, route tasks and post updates.
agents.pricing: Trial on Free; full agent on Business, $20/seat/mo

agents.name: Rovo
agents.oneLiner: Search, chat and agents across Jira, Confluence and connected tools.
agents.standout: Agents use links between people, projects and code to draft roadmaps and route backlog work.
agents.pricing: Included with Atlassian Cloud Standard, Premium or Enterprise (usage credits)

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.oneLiner: Agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files and runs commands.
agents.standout: Kick off a task from Slack or GitHub and get back a pull request.
agents.pricing: Included with paid Claude plans; Team $20/seat/mo billed annually

agents.name: Cursor
agents.oneLiner: AI code editor whose agents plan, build and test features.
agents.standout: Launch cloud agents in parallel that build, test and demo features on their own machines.
agents.pricing: Free plan; paid plans on site

agents.name: GitHub Copilot
agents.oneLiner: Coding agent that picks up GitHub issues and returns reviewed pull requests.
agents.standout: Hand an issue to the cloud agent and get a pull request back for review.

agents.name: Codex
agents.oneLiner: Coding agent running in the cloud, desktop app, IDE and terminal.
agents.standout: Runs tasks in the cloud while your laptop is closed and checks work with browser tools.
agents.pricing: Included with ChatGPT Plus, Pro and Business

agents.name: Devin Desktop
agents.oneLiner: AI IDE, formerly Windsurf, with a command center for many agents.
agents.standout: A lead agent splits long tasks among subagents that each open their own pull requests.

agents.name: Claude
agents.oneLiner: General AI assistant on web, desktop and mobile for writing, analysis and research.
agents.forWho: Designers, PMs and anyone doing knowledge work
agents.standout: Paid plans also include Claude Code, so one subscription covers thinking and building.

agents.name: ChatGPT agent
agents.oneLiner: ChatGPT mode that uses its own browser to complete multi-step tasks.
agents.forWho: Anyone delegating web research and busywork
agents.standout: Researches across sites and builds a slideshow or spreadsheet, asking before important steps.
agents.pricing: Included with ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise

agents.name: Comet
agents.oneLiner: AI browser with a built-in assistant that researches and acts on pages.
agents.forWho: People who live in the browser
agents.standout: Compare how different sources cover a topic, or draft an email reply, without leaving the page.

workflows.title: Library-true screen to shipped code
steps: Draft the screen with the Figma agent using your own components
Bring it into Wonder and explore variations on the canvas
Have Claude Code build the chosen version in its own worktree
workflows.outcome: A reviewed preview built from your design system, ready to merge

workflows.title: Idea to tested prototype in a day
steps: Draft the PRD from meeting notes in ChatPRD
Open the spec in v0 to build a clickable app
Run an unmoderated prototype test with Maze participants
workflows.outcome: A working prototype with real user feedback attached

workflows.title: Interviews straight into the roadmap
steps: Run AI-moderated interviews at scale with Listen Labs
Bring transcripts and feedback into Dovetail for cited themes
Route ranked needs to Linear as issues
workflows.outcome: Customer evidence linked to every roadmap issue

workflows.title: Whiteboard sketch to Figma prototype
steps: Photograph the sketch and generate screens in Stitch
Paste the designs into Figma for cleanup
Turn the frames into a working prototype with Figma Make
workflows.outcome: An interactive prototype built from a rough sketch

workflows.title: Hand UI fixes to a coding agent
steps: Log design QA issues in Linear
Delegate each issue to Cursor or Codex from Linear
Review the returned pull requests with GitHub Copilot code review
workflows.outcome: Design polish shipped as reviewed pull requests

workflows.title: Competitive scan to product brief
steps: Have ChatGPT agent browse competitor sites and build a comparison
Summarize gaps and opportunities with Claude
Save the brief and next steps in Notion with Notion Agent
workflows.outcome: A sourced competitor brief your team can act on
